# App icon test fixtures

`synthetic/` is a made-up icon (simple shapes, written for these tests) in silica-icons format 2,
under the repository licence (MIT OR Apache-2.0), and so are the `synthetic-*` goldens.
`golden/` holds PNGs rendered by `tools/compose.py` of silica-icons (`gen.py` regenerates them).
The `mustache-*`, `terminal-*` and `clock-*` files are renders (128 px, dynamic layers left out)
of the pilot icons of [silica-icons](https://github.com/silica-os/silica-icons), which is
CC BY-SA 4.0: those files carry that licence (see `ASSETS.md`).
